title: Suresh Sallay’s treatment under PTA is deeply troubling - Namal Rajapaksa
summary: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) National Organizer Namal Rajapaksa said that concerns raised before court by the legal counsel of Major General (Retd.) Suresh Sallay regarding his treatment in custody, was deeply troubling and asked why activists who were against the PTA maintained such a silence.

title: Suresh Salley being used as a scapegoat, says wife following CID visit
summary: Speaking to the media for the first time outside the Criminal Investigation Department (CID), Manory Salley, the wife of former Major General Suresh Salley, defended her husband, insisting that he is innocent and is being unfairly used as a ’’scapegoat.’’

title: White House AI policy adviser Krishnan to leave position
summary: A top White House artificial intelligence policy adviser ‌on Saturday said he will leave his position at the end of June, marking the exit of a leading figure helping craft policies for frontier technologies.

title: Anthropic urges AI labs to pause development, warns humans risk losing control
summary: Anthropic is calling on major artificial intelligence labs to consider a coordinated and verifiable pause in development, warning that rapid advances in the technology could soon allow AI systems to improve themselves faster than society ‌can manage the risks.

title: Reservoirs 63% full, water secured for Yala season: Irrigation Department
summary: The 73 major reservoirs managed by the Irrigation Department have collectively reached 63 percent of their total storage capacity, providing sufficient water to meet irrigation requirements for the ongoing Yala cultivation season, officials said.

title: Fishermen, naval community warned to stay ashore as seas turn dangerous
summary: The Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre has issued a Red Warning for strong winds and rough seas, effective from 6.30 a.m. on June 7 until 10.30 a.m. today (8), urging fishing and naval communities to take immediate precautions.

title: SJB expels five Bulathsinhala Pradeshiya Sabha members over bribery allegations
summary: The Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) has decided to strip five of its members representing the Bulathsinhala Pradeshiya Sabha of their positions. The expelled members include SJB Group Leader Nihal Mendis, Mohamed Nishard, Kanthi Pelawatta, Ayesha Chamali, and Pushpa Samarasinghe.

title: US eyes Iranian assets for Gulf allies’ reconstruction, source says
summary: The U.S. government will attempt to redirect Iranian assets to Gulf states for rebuilding and repairs of damage caused by Iran, a source familiar with the matter said, as Tehran followed up a wave of strikes ‌against Kuwait and Bahrain with further drone launches.

title: Hit-and-run by drunk driver kills two women
summary: Two women have tragically lost their lives after being struck by a car on the Embulgama-Panagoda in Hanwella.

title: Divisional Secretaries to boycott Monday meetings from tomorrow
summary: The Sri Lanka Association of Divisional Secretaries and Assistant Divisional Secretaries said that its members will completely withdraw from participating in any official meetings scheduled on Mondays, effective from tomorrow, June 8. This decision applies to all physical as well as virtual (online) meetings usually conducted on this specific day.

title: Manhunt for suspects after 12 people shot near festival in Ohio
summary: Police say they are searching for suspects after at least 12 people were shot near a festival in Toledo, in the midwestern US state of Ohio.

title: Public views sought for new higher education policy framework
summary: The Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education has launched a public consultation process to gather views and recommendations for the formulation of Sri Lanka’s proposed National Higher Education Policy Framework.

title: Iran World Cup team heads to Mexico as US visa row erupts
summary: Iran’s World Cup squad left Turkey for Mexico on Saturday, taking off under the shadow of a bitter diplomatic row between Tehran and Washington after the US refused to issue visas for some of the team’s support squad.
